capabilities: Trigger an autocomplete dropdown of relationship types by typing @ in a wikilink alias
Sync matched @types to YAML frontmatter fields on save
Support multiple @types per wikilink in natural display text
Configure relationship types (key, label, description) via the plugin's data.json
Leave frontmatter and @type text intact when the plugin is uninstalled
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pre-release versions install via BRAT. AI-assisted relationship discovery is documented in a separate skill/SKILL.md rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian wikilinks have no way to express the kind of relationship between notes, and typed links usually require hand-editing YAML frontmatter.

relations.evidence: Dataview | Yes | Reads YAML frontmatter natively
Graph Link Types | Yes | Reads frontmatter via Dataview
PENgram handles ingestion; Wikilink Types handles the connections.
The Vault Linker skill lets AI agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, etc.) analyze your vault

summary: Typed-wikilink plugin that autocompletes @relationship types inside wikilink aliases and syncs them to YAML frontmatter on save.
